how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-ragefire-chasm-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:5722:obj:0: Search Ragefire Chasm for Maur Grimtotem's corpse and search it for any items of interest.
rows.quest:5722:details:0: The troggs are not the only thing that interested Magatha in Ragefire Chasm. She has heard word that one of her servants, a Maur Grimtotem, found something peculiar while in the Chasm, but he never made it out to show her what. She'd like Maur's body found--if it still exists--and any signs of what he found while attempting to speak to the troggs.
rows.quest:5722:details:1: BReturn to Magatha any items of interest, and I'm sure she would be very generous in her reward.
rows.quest:5722:details:2: BAgain, seek the Chasm in the darkest areas of ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:5722:completion:0: The body looks seriously beaten by clubs or fists, but most of the corpse's clothing and equipment still looks present. It seems the troggs do not overly care much for material wealth.
rows.quest:5722:completion:1: BYou begin to search the body for anything of interest that might help Magatha.
rows.quest:5723:obj:0: Search ⟦E1⟧ for Ragefire Chasm, then kill 8 Ragefire Troggs and 8 Ragefire ⟦E2⟧ before returning to Rahauro in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:5723:details:0: Beneath the city of ⟦E1⟧, stout creatures known as troggs started coming to the surface from deep below the lava filled tunnels. In her ever-benevolence, Magatha sought to make peace with the creatures, but they turned on her diplomats, killing them. She will not allow such treatment of the tauren people and now consider the creatures a threat to all of the ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:5723:details:1: BShe asks that you put an end to this trogg threat before it overwhelms the ⟦E4⟧ from below. Find Ragefire Chasm and destroy them all.
rows.quest:5723:completion:0: I am glad to see you took Magatha's task seriously. Thank you, ⟦1⟧. I'm sure the troggs will have a harder time coming to the surface with their numbers so greatly reduced.
rows.quest:5723:completion:1: BPerhaps in the future we can take time to figure out where such creatures came from, and what they really want.
rows.quest:5724:obj:0: Take the Grimtotem Satchel to Rahauro in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:5724:details:0: You find a satchel under the body of the tauren. It is still gripped tightly in his arms as though he was trying to protect it while being attacked by the troggs.
rows.quest:5724:details:1: BRemoving the satchel from his vice-like grip, you stow it with your own equipment and prepare to make your way out of the tunnels and back to Rahauro in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:5724:completion:1: BMagatha told me that if you were successful in finding her clansman that you be given this. Please, take it in thanks.
rows.quest:5725:obj:0: Bring the books Spells of Shadow and Incantations from the Nether to Varimathras in ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:5725:details:0: Many denizens of the Legion bestow gifts on their followers as you may well know. Some of these gifts the Dark Lady feels would be better off in her hands than in the hands of those with... lesser vision.
rows.quest:5725:details:1: BA sect of the ⟦E6⟧ hidden in caverns below ⟦E1⟧ known as the Searing Blade are a prime example. The Lady tells me that members of the Searing Blade have come into the possession of two powerful spell books--she would like to "borrow" these books from them. You will get them for her.
rows.quest:5725:completion:0: Good, ⟦3⟧. You have done well in serving the Dark Lady. Your continued perseverance and ambition will be of great use to the Lady's subjects. Return to me again in the future. Perhaps I will have other tasks for you that will aid the Dark Lady in her attempts at overtaking the Lich King and completely freeing the Scourge.
rows.quest:5728:obj:0: Kill Bazzalan and Jergosh the Invoker before returning to Thrall in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:5728:details:0: Hmm, leaders of the Searing Blade... this concerns me most. If they are the ones of value to Neeru, then those are who we must target first. This satyr... Bazzalan, and the other Neeru mentioned--what was he, a warlock?--must be slain.
rows.quest:5728:details:1: BReturn to the Cleft of Shadow and enter Ragefire Chasm, ⟦4⟧. Find these two leaders of the Searing Blade, and kill them. But be careful not to let Neeru know it was you who did this. You must retain your identity as one of his ⟦5⟧ in arms.
rows.quest:5728:completion:0: I am glad you've returned, ⟦6⟧. Some of those loyal to me brought word immediately that the caverns below ⟦E1⟧ were in disarray now that their leaders have been slain. I even heard reports that Neeru was more than agitated. It seems we've put a dent in his armor. I can't say I'm displeased... even with such a minor victory.
rows.quest:5761:obj:0: Enter Ragefire Chasm and slay Taragaman the Hungerer, then bring his heart back to Neeru Fireblade in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:5761:details:0: The primary task set upon me by our great Warchief is to root out the creatures responsible for infesting our lord's great city with demonic influence. The Burning Blade is one threat, but there are others; the Searing Blade for instance, who make their home in Ragefire Chasm, secretly attempting to subvert innocent members of the ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:5761:details:1: BIf they are to be stopped, then their leader must be slain--a Felguard named Taragaman the Hungerer.
rows.quest:5761:details:2: BKill him, and his heart will appease Thrall, of this I'm sure.
rows.quest:5761:completion:0: Ha! You've done it! Thrall will be so pleased.
rows.quest:5761:completion:1: BI will ensure this heart is taken care of properly.
rows.quest:5761:completion:2: BFor now though, you must celebrate your victory. I will inform Thrall of your success.
